[P1] PAW
PATROL
汪汪队立大功儿童安全救援故事书
你好,奇异鸟
美国尼克儿童频道／著
安东尼／译

[P2] 莱德和汪汪队的狗狗们正在沙滩上开心地打排球。
“快传球啊！”路马和小砾大叫道。
这时，阿宝船长和他的朋友也加入进来。
阿宝船长说：“大家好！这是我的表哥法兰索瓦，
从法国来的。”
法兰索瓦开心地和大家打招呼，“我觉得排球是
唯一比足球更好玩的球类，咱们一起玩吧！”，

[P3] 阿宝船长让表哥和汪汪队玩球，自己先离开了。
阿宝船长对莱德说：“我在海湾那边发现了一只很奇怪的蓝脚鸟。如果我能把它拍下来，说不定可以登上《海鸟月刊》的封面呢！
“祝你好运！”莱德说。
阿宝船长站在船上用望远镜瞭望，他发现表哥法兰索瓦跑去玩拖伞冲浪。
“希望法兰索瓦闹出的动静不会把我的奇异鸟给吓跑。”
船长在心里想着。

[P4] 突然，海象华力把头探出水面开始大叫起来。一开始阿宝船长还不明白是怎么回事，但当他顺着华力指的方向看去时，他惊喜地发现了蓝脚奇异鸟。
“它在那里！它就在我的船上啊！”船长兴奋极了。
阿宝船长只顾着给鸟儿拍照，结果一不小心掉进了水里。他落水的动静实在是太大了，一下子把鸟儿给吓跑了。
“哦，不！快给我回来！”船长冲着鸟儿离去的方向大叫道。
他沮丧极了。

[P5] 华力来找汪汪队帮忙，莱德和狗狗们还在沙滩上玩呢。
“嘿，华力，发生了什么事情吗？”莱德问道。
华力大吼一声，将前肢比成翅膀的形状。莱德一看恍然大悟。
莱德急切地说：“是阿宝船长！他一定是发现了奇异鸟，但是他的船可能出了什么问题，我想，他现在急需我们的帮助。”
莱德拿出他的平板电脑，说道：“没有困难的工作，只有勇敢的狗狗。汪汪队员们，马上到塔台集合！”，

[P6] 不一会儿，狗狗们在塔台集合完毕，随时准备出发。
莱德说：“狗狗们，阿宝船长现在急需我们的帮助。他原本是想拍摄一只蓝脚奇异鸟的，可是他现在却在海湾遇到了危险。”
“路马，你负责用救生圈把船长救回到他的船上。”
“包在我身上！”路马回答。
“天天，你负责在空中搜寻奇异鸟的巢穴！”
“狗狗要飞上天啦！”天天回答。

[P7] 莱德、路马和天天迅速赶到海湾。
“阿宝船长在那儿！”路马喊道。
莱德叫道：“坚持住，阿宝船长！路马过去救你，我马上会把你的船开过来。”
路马立刻把救生圈抛向阿宝船长，并顺利地把他救到了自己的船上。
“真是太感谢你了，路马！”阿宝船长感激地说。

[P8] 当路马和阿宝船长登上“比目鱼号”的甲板时，莱德和天天已经在那儿等候他们了。
“我们会帮助你拍到奇异鸟照片的。”莱德说。
“太感谢你们了！”阿宝船长激动地说。
突然，法兰索瓦冲了过来，差点儿撞到他的表弟。
“放心吧，表弟，我一定帮你拍到鸟儿的照片。”
船长听了，心里隐隐觉得有些不安。

[P9] 这时，天天正驾驶着直升机盘旋在海湾的上空，她仔细地搜寻着每个角落。功夫不负有心人，她终于在崖壁上发现了奇异鸟的巢穴。

“我看见奇异鸟啦！那蓝色的脚我一定不会认错的！”天天对着头盔对讲机喊道。

阿宝船长高兴地叫着：“就是它！你找到了！”

[P10] 法兰索瓦降落在奇异鸟的旁边，拿出了相机。
“看镜头，‘茄子’！”法兰索瓦喊道。这时，不知怎么的，奇异鸟突然朝他冲了过来。
“你疯了吗？”法兰索瓦惊讶地叫道。
大家惊讶地发现法兰索瓦背着他的拖伞离开了。
船长叫道：“停下，法兰索瓦！你这样会吓到奇异鸟的！”
远处传来了法兰索瓦的声音：“放心吧，我一定会帮你拍到照片的……”

[P11] 法兰索瓦一不留神便被鸟儿撞下了悬崖，幸好他及时用手抓住了崖壁。
天天发现后赶紧飞了过来，把阿宝船长垂降到了法兰索瓦的身边。
阿宝船长急切地说：“快抓住我，法兰索瓦！我来救你！”
法兰索瓦叫道：“救命啊，表弟！这是一只疯鸟！”
这时，只见奇异鸟用爪子重重地踩了一下法兰索瓦抓在崖壁上的手，法兰索瓦不幸掉进了大海。

[P12] 幸运的是，狗狗们及时把法兰索瓦救到了船上。

阿宝船长来到了奇异鸟的面前，他温柔地说：“你好，美丽的鸟儿！请问我能给你拍张照吗？”

鸟儿很开心地摆了个姿势。

“咔嚓！”

上了船的法兰索瓦，仍然在瑟瑟发抖。

“你还好吗？”船长问。

法兰索瓦打着冷战说：“我，我……还好。幸亏有表弟和狗狗们。”

[P13] 几天后，船长在公园里给莱德送了一件礼物。
“为了表示感谢，我把这张奇异鸟的照片送给你！”船长说。
“谢谢你！有困难就找汪汪队！”莱德说道。

full_text_en:
[P1] PAW
PATROL
Paw Patrol: Children's Safety Rescue Storybook
Hello, Strange Bird
Nickelodeon / Author
Anthony / Translator

[P2] Ryder and the Paw Patrol pups are happily playing volleyball on the beach.
"Pass the ball!" Rubble and Zuma shout.
At this moment, Captain Barnacles and his friend join in.
Captain Barnacles says, "Hello everyone! This is my cousin Francois, from France."
Francois happily greets everyone, "I think volleyball is the only sport better than soccer, let's play together!"

[P3] Captain Barnacles let his cousin and the Paw Patrol play ball and left first.
Captain Barnacles said to Ryder, "I spotted a very strange blue-footed bird over in the bay. If I can get a photo of it, maybe I can make the cover of 'Seabird Monthly'!"
"Good luck!" Ryder said.
Captain Barnacles stood on the boat, looking through his telescope, and saw his cousin Francois going parasailing.
"I hope Francois's noise doesn't scare my exotic bird away," the captain thought to himself.

[P4] Suddenly, the walrus, Wallace, popped his head out of the water and started shouting. At first, Captain Barnacles didn't understand what was happening, but when he looked in the direction Wallace pointed, he was delighted to spot the blue-footed booby.
"There it is! It's right on my boat!" the captain exclaimed with excitement.
Captain Barnacles was so focused on taking pictures of the bird that he accidentally fell into the water. The splash he made was so big that it scared the bird away.
"Oh, no! Come back!" the captain shouted toward the direction the bird had flown.
He was extremely disappointed.

[P5] Wally came to ask the Paw Patrol for help. Ryder and the pups were still playing on the beach.
"Hey, Wally, what's going on?" Ryder asked.
Wally let out a loud cry and held his front flippers up like wings. Ryder looked and suddenly understood.
Ryder said anxiously, "It's Captain Barnacles! He must have spotted the exotic bird, but his boat might be in trouble. I think he needs our help right away."
Ryder took out his tablet and said, "There's no such thing as a difficult job, only brave pups. Paw Patrol, to the Lookout, now!"

[P6] In no time, the pups had gathered at the Lookout and were ready to go.
Ryder said, "Pups, Captain Barnacles needs our help. He was trying to photograph a blue-footed booby, but now he's in danger in the bay."
"Zuma, you're in charge of using the life ring to rescue the captain back to his boat."
"You can count on me!" Zuma replied.
"Skye, you're responsible for searching the sky for the booby's nest!"
"Pups are flying!" Skye answered.

[P7] Ryder, Zuma, and Skye quickly arrived at the bay.
"Captain Barnacles is over there!" Zuma shouted.
Ryder called out, "Hang on, Captain Barnacles! Zuma is going to rescue you, and I'll get your boat over here right away."
Zuma immediately threw a life ring to Captain Barnacles and successfully pulled him onto his own boat.
"Thank you so much, Zuma!" Captain Barnacles said gratefully.

[P8] When Rubble and Captain Barnacles climbed onto the deck of the 'Blowfish', Ryder and Sky were already waiting for them.
'We'll help you get a photo of the exotic bird,' Ryder said.
'Thank you so much!' Captain Barnacles said excitedly.
Suddenly, Francois rushed over and almost bumped into his cousin.
'Don't worry, cousin, I'll definitely help you get a photo of the bird.'
Captain Barnacles listened and felt a bit uneasy inside.

[P9] At this moment, Skye was piloting her helicopter, circling above the bay, carefully searching every corner. Her efforts paid off — she finally spotted the nest of the exotic bird on the cliffside.

"I see the exotic bird! I'd never mistake those blue feet!" Skye shouted into her helmet communicator.

Captain Barnacles cheered excitedly, "That's it! You found it!"

[P10] Francois landed next to the exotic bird and took out his camera.
"Look at the lens, 'cheese'!" Francois shouted. Suddenly, for some reason, the exotic bird charged towards him.
"Are you crazy?" Francois exclaimed in surprise.
Everyone was surprised to see Francois leaving with his parasail.
The Captain called out, "Stop, Francois! You'll scare the exotic bird like that!"
From afar came Francois's voice: "Don't worry, I'll definitely help you get the photo..."

[P11] Francois was knocked off the cliff by a bird, but luckily he grabbed onto the cliff face in time.
Skye noticed and quickly flew over, lowering Captain Barnacles down to Francois's side.
Captain Barnacles urgently said, "Grab onto me, Francois! I'm here to save you!"
Francois cried out, "Help! Little brother! This bird is crazy!"
At that moment, the strange bird stepped heavily on Francois's hand gripping the cliff, and Francois unfortunately fell into the sea.

[P12] Luckily, the pups rescued Francois onto the boat in time.

Captain Barnacles approached the strange bird and gently said, "Hello, beautiful bird! May I take a photo of you?"

The bird happily struck a pose.

"Click!"

Francois, now on the boat, was still trembling.

"Are you okay?" asked the captain.

Francois shivered and said, "I, I... I'm okay. Lucky to have my cousin and the pups."

[P13] A few days later, Captain Barnacles gave Ryder a gift in the park.
"To show my thanks, I'm giving you this photo of the strange bird!" said Captain Barnacles.
"Thank you! When you have trouble, call the PAW Patrol!" said Ryder.

[P1] 本页是《汪汪队立大功儿童安全救援故事书》的封面，标题为《你好，奇异鸟》，作者为美国尼克儿童频道，译者为安东尼。画面中，汪汪队成员小砾驾驶着车辆，天空中有一只奇异鸟飞过。
[P2] 莱德和汪汪队的狗狗们在沙滩上打排球，阿宝船长和他的表哥法兰索瓦加入进来，法兰索瓦表示想和大家一起玩排球。
[P3] 阿宝船长离开排球游戏，独自在船上用望远镜观察海湾，发现表哥法兰索瓦在玩拖伞冲浪，并担心他的活动会吓跑他发现的奇异鸟。
[P4] 阿宝船长在海象华力的指引下发现了蓝脚奇异鸟，兴奋地拍照时却不慎落水，巨大的动静吓跑了鸟儿，他因此感到沮丧。
[P5] 海象华力找到汪汪队求助，莱德通过华力比划翅膀的动作，意识到阿宝船长可能遇到了麻烦，于是立即召集汪汪队成员前往塔台集合。
[P6] 汪汪队在塔台集合完毕，莱德向狗狗们说明阿宝船长在海湾遇险的情况，并分配任务：路马负责用救生圈救船长，天天负责在空中搜寻奇异鸟的巢穴。
[P7] 莱德、路马和天天赶到海湾，路马用救生圈救起落水的阿宝船长，阿宝船长对路马表示感谢。
[P8] 路马和阿宝船长登上“比目鱼号”后，莱德和天天已在甲板上等候，承诺帮助拍摄奇异鸟照片。阿宝船长感激不已，但表哥法兰索瓦突然冲来，表示要帮忙拍照，让船长感到不安。
[P9] 天天驾驶直升机在海湾上空搜寻，成功在崖壁上发现了奇异鸟的巢穴，并通过无线电向阿宝船长报告，船长对此感到非常高兴。
[P10] 法兰索瓦降落在奇异鸟旁准备拍照，鸟儿突然冲向他，他惊叫后背起拖伞离开，船长担心他吓到鸟儿并呼喊阻止，法兰索瓦则表示会拍到照片。
[P11] 法兰索瓦被奇异鸟撞下悬崖，抓住崖壁后被阿宝船长和天天救援，但奇异鸟踩中他的手，导致他掉入大海。
[P12] 阿宝船长成功与奇异鸟互动并拍下照片，而法兰索瓦被救上船后仍心有余悸，向船长表示感谢。
[P13] 几天后，阿宝船长在公园里将一张奇异鸟的照片作为礼物送给莱德，以表达感谢，莱德回应说有困难就找汪汪队。
